title.narrative: Preparation for Support Initiative for Belarusian Youth NGOs 2.0

description.narrative: The preparatory study for RADA-Silba partnership aims at improving and expanding the activities fulfilled during the Pilot project ?Support Initiative for Belarusian Youth CSOs?, such as training of trainers, as well as building an improved strategy for the project, which will aim at strengthening youth organisation affected by the civil society crackdown and other political and legal contexts currently relevant for Belarusian youth, while also engaging and re-engaging old and new volunteers in activities. Additionally, in preparation for the partnership project, the preparatory study will strengthen the partnership between RADA and Silba by improving communication flow and managerial planning.
